headline: Base Ledgers Shift on Several Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Callum’s Cape has moved from six Warden bases and one neutral to four Warden and three Colonial, while Marban Hollow now stands at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Mooring County has also shifted to 11 Warden and one Colonial base. Callum’s Cape remains sharply active, with 11 event rows in the latest two hours, chiefly at Naofa and Scouts Jest; Mooring County logged five. Weathered Expanse retains seven Warden bases and two neutral, but recorded three rows in the same span. Linn Mercy, still ten Colonial and one neutral, logged six recent rows and 30 over 24 hours. Godcrofts is another fresh point of activity: seven event rows, all at Isawa, with all nine bases still Colonial-held. Marban Hollow has been quieter lately, with none in two hours, though four rows fell within six. Nevish Line has had no events in two hours, and Callahan’s Passage remains wholly Warden-held with none in six. The war is undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
